title: A2UI Evaluation Dataset Schema
description: Schema for A2UI evaluation datasets and data points.

name.description: Unique identifier for this evaluation sample.

dataset.description: Name of the dataset this data point belongs to. If omitted, inferred from the YAML file name.

description.description: Human-readable explanation of what this sample tests.

catalog.description: Path to a custom catalog JSON file. Supports the '{version}' placeholder. Either this or 'catalogs' is required.

catalogs.description: The active catalogs, in order; the first is the default. Use instead of 'catalog' to test multi-catalog prompts, per-catalog pruning or per-catalog examples.

path.description: Path to the catalog JSON file, relative to the repository root. Supports the '{version}' placeholder.

catalog_id.description: Catalog id to use when the document states none.

allowed_components.description: Component names to keep (ComponentPruningTransformer). Omit to keep every component.

allowed_functions.description: Function names to keep (FunctionPruningTransformer). Omit to keep every function.

examples.description: Paths, relative to the repository root, of JSON files holding few-shot example payloads for this catalog.
Paths, relative to the repository root, of JSON files holding few-shot example payloads for the single 'catalog'.

allowed_messages.description: Message types the model may write. Omit to allow all of them.

initial_state.description: A2UI messages applied to a fresh renderer state before the model's turn is validated, so the turn can update an existing surface.

stream_chunk_size.description: When set, the bridge also feeds the completion through the format's streaming parser in slices of this many characters.

tags.description: Free-form tags used to select subsets of samples, such as 'smoke', 'multi_catalog', 'pruned' or 'stateful'.

assertions.description: Deterministic checks on the compiled A2UI messages, run before the LLM judge. An empty list asserts nothing.

required_components.description: Component types that must appear at least once.

forbidden_components.description: Component types that must not appear.

required_bindings.description: Data model paths that must be bound or written, such as '/booking/date'.

required_actions.description: Action event names that must be dispatched by some component.

message_types.description: The only message types the payload may contain.

catalog_ids.description: Catalog ids that must be named by some surface or component.

messages.description: Ordered chat completion messages preceding and including the final UI generation request.

content.description: Text content of the user message.
Optional text response generated by the assistant.

tool_calls.description: List of tool calls made by the assistant in native Inspect AI ToolCall format.

id.description: Unique identifier for the tool call.

function.description: Function name directly as a string.

content.description: Execution output returned by the tool.

tool_call_id.description: Identifier linking this tool response to its preceding assistant tool call.

function.description: Optional function name for the tool response.

promptText.description: Legacy single-turn user prompt (deprecated; automatically migrated to messages).

target.description: Expected outcome and rubric criteria for LLM-as-a-judge scoring. If omitted, defaults to description.

system_prompt.description: Domain-specific system prompt unrelated to A2UI (e.g., application persona, business rules). Merged with the A2UI SDK system prompt during solver execution.

protocol_role.description: A2UI protocol role instruction passed to the SDK prompt generator.

generation_rules.description: A2UI protocol workflow rules appended to the SDK workflow prompt.

allowed_surface_ids.description: Allowed surface IDs for the output.
